verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's page does publish some concrete numbers (18-core CPU, up to 5.0GHz boost, 85 TOPS NPU, 228GB/s LPDDR5x bandwidth) rather than pure adjectives, but it omits TDP/power envelope, process node, max memory capacity, and test conditions for the TOPS/clock figures — gaps confirmed both by the docs themselves and by community commenters explicitly asking for TDP data and benchmarks that Qualcomm didn't provide. missing for 10: published TDP/power figures, stated test conditions for TOPS/clock claims, process node, max memory capacity, independent benchmark corroboration.
